editorial: Imagine stepping into a city that has slipped into a fog‑laden nightmare, where every shadow could be your last. A fractured visual language turns the metropolis into a labyrinth of suspense, making the environment feel like an additional character. Joaquin Phoenix earns every scene with an almost silent, almost a‑coustic sense of dread that anchors the film's cold, relentless pace. You will find yourself on a taut edge, driven to uncover why the mist will swallow all you love. Fans of atmospheric dread who thrive on a story that refuses to resolve early will feel right at home.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
